name: KIWI Wattens
kurzbeschreibung:
**Discover KIWI Wattens in Wattens**

Welcome to **KIWI Wattens**, your adventure playground in the heart of **Tirol**! Just a stone’s throw from **Innsbruck**, this unique theme park combines nature, thrills, and relaxation for all ages.

**Thrilling Rides & Family Fun**
Experience heart-pounding excitement on our **Coaster**, **Skyflyer**, or **Bobsleigh**. Little ones will love the gentle **Mini Coaster** and **Carousels**, while the **Log Flume** promises splashes of fun for the whole family.

**Nature & Relaxation**
Stroll through our **Alpine Garden**, enjoy a picnic by the lake, or unwind in our **Wellness Oasis** with saunas and relaxation zones. The **KIWI Wattens** area is also home to the **Alpine Zoo**, where you can meet native and exotic animals up close.

**Culinary Delights**
Fuel up with fresh **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a juicy **Schweinsbraten** at our **Hofkeller** restaurant. Don’t miss our **Ice Cream Parlor** for homemade treats!

**Events & Special Experiences**
From **Halloween Spooktaculars** to **Christmas Markets**, **KIWI Wattens** hosts year-round events. Try **Night Rides** under the stars or enjoy live music and festivals in our outdoor arena.

**Practical Info**
📍 **Location:** Wattens, near **Innsbruck** (just 10 minutes from the city center)
🚗 **Parking:** Free on-site parking available
🎟 **Tickets:** Online booking recommended for discounts
📅 **Opening Hours:** Daily from **10:00 AM** (varies by season)

Plan your unforgettable day at **KIWI Wattens**—where adventure meets **Tiroler Gemütlichkeit**! 🌄✨
